invariants.rationale: Method execution reaches this point only if actor is not null due to the early return.
The value of width is adjusted to be at least minWidth before setBounds is called.
The value of height is adjusted to be at least minHeight before setBounds is called.
If maxWidth is positive, width is capped at maxWidth. Otherwise, no upper bound is enforced.
If maxHeight is positive, height is capped at maxHeight, as ensured by the conditional assignments.
